_comment: TEST-PRECON consumption of EPIC-PREP downstream_hints provisioning, discover ref_principal_provision fixtures, and COVERAGE-REINFORCE setup detail_lines. Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/test-precon.md. Verifier: precon_verify.py --strict-principal / --mode principal. Upstream: docs/epic-prep-principal-contract.json, docs/discover-principal-contract.json, docs/coverage-reinforce-principal-contract.json, docs/precon-topology-contract.json.

placeholder_scan.ref_filter: obligations_proposed[] where downstream_hints.needs_environment_provision == true OR kind == environment_setup
placeholder_scan.dual_account: when any obligation has downstream_hints.needs_dual_account_contrast == true emit group_key_enrg and group_key_oppt (or documented alias pair per epic-prep-principal)

placeholder_emit_rules.provision_extras: per placeholder_scan; all values angle-bracket form e.g. <group_key_enrg>
placeholder_emit_rules.forbidden: password-like literals, long numeric account_group_id digits, probe account names

provision_cluster_rules.satisfies_fixture_ids: from provision fixture id e.g. fix-env-001
provision_cluster_rules.satisfies_check_ids: from fixture linked_check_ids e.g. chk-s1 chk-s2
provision_cluster_rules.step_voice: imperative Jira action-result; console-first account group hierarchy FxConfiguration publish streams; placeholders only
provision_cluster_rules.coverage_setup: MAY link tb-setup skeleton covers_check_ids or satisfy via cluster satisfies_check_ids only

sources: coverage checks verification_role out_of_epic with coverage_thread deferral_only
deferral_skip_rules.action: skip Phase 4R/4D for deferral-keyed checks; excluded_checks_with_reason or omit from skeleton case_outline

emit_fields.sources.principal_loaded: true when provision obligations/fixtures or principal personas consumed
emit_fields.principal_provenance: optional block documenting ref/discover/coverage principal slice ids

strict_precon_principal_verifier.skip_when: no ref provision obligations and discover sources.principal_loaded false (metrics env-thread optional)
checks: when ref provision + discover ref_principal_provision: sources.principal_loaded true
precon_clusters row pc-setup satisfies fixture id and setup linked_check_ids
session_placeholders includes group_key_enrg and group_key_oppt when ref needs_dual_account_contrast
validation_log contains phase1-principal and phase3-provision when provision cluster emitted
deferral-keyed checks not in test_skeleton covers_check_ids without excluded_checks_with_reason
validation_log phase4_skipped_deferral_keyed when deferral skip applied

CLOSE.use: Terminal cross-artifact principal lint (Round 2 step 8); see docs/close-principal-contract.json
